question: Does parameter-free LayerNorm on GPTrans pair updates maintain its 100K gain (+0.004843 eV) upon 500K scale-transfer to surpass the GPTrans-T 500K baseline (0.106868 eV) by at least 0.003 eV?

hypothesis.observed_deficiency: During extended training on PCQM4Mv2, newly accumulated pair updates experience unbounded magnitude growth that causes representation collapse. Normalizing each new pair update with LayerNorm stabilizes relational updates across 60 epochs.
alternative_explanations: 500K sample diversity natively bounds relational update variance, rendering update normalization ineffective
hypothesis.changed_mechanism: LayerNorm normalization applied to each newly computed pair update tensor before residual accumulation
hypothesis.cheapest_falsifier: 60-epoch 500K/50K run failing to achieve 0.003 eV gain over the 0.106868 eV baseline (threshold < 0.103868 eV)
hypothesis.decision_changed_if_positive: nominate GPTrans Pair Update Norm as a required scale-transfer mechanism
hypothesis.decision_changed_if_negative: close standalone Pair Update Norm scale-transfer at 500K
